description: Corrected lateral portal test. The seed point is now required to be enclosed in all 12 in-plane sectors before rays are cast, which fixes the previous run where the PTM1 and rhodopsin seed points fell outside the helical bundle. Reports mid-membrane interior cavity radius, the largest probe that can travel laterally from the cavity to the bilayer, and the PTM1 residues lining that path.
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
 'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W',
 'TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
VDW={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80,'P':1.80,'SE':1.90}
def parse_txt(txt, chains=None, resmin=None):
    rows=[]
    for line in txt.splitlines():
        if not line.startswith(('ATOM  ','HETATM')): continue
        rn=line[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in AA3: continue
        ch=line[21]
        if chains and ch not in chains: continue
        if line[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        try: resi=int(line[22:26])
        except: continue
        if resmin is not None and resi<resmin: continue
        nm=line[12:16].strip(); el=(line[76:78].strip() or nm[0]).upper()
        if el in ('H','D'): continue
        rows.append((ch,resi,AA3[rn],nm,el,float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['ch','resi','aa','atom','el','x','y','z'])
def get(u):
    r=requests.get(u,timeout=90); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text

af=requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/P32857',timeout=90).json()
S={}
S['PTM1 (AF P32857)']=dict(df=parse_txt(get(af[0]['pdbUrl']),resmin=27),
    tm=[('A',198,218),('A',231,251),('A',266,286),('A',305,325),('A',334,354),('A',382,402),('A',418,438)])
S['TMEM87A (8CTJ)']=dict(df=parse_txt(get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/8CTJ.pdb'),chains={'A'}),
    tm=[('A',229,249),('A',262,282),('A',297,317),('A',330,350),('A',359,379),('A',407,427),('A',439,459)])
S['Rhodopsin (1U19)']=dict(df=parse_txt(get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/1U19.pdb'),chains={'A'}),
    tm=[('A',35,64),('A',71,100),('A',107,139),('A',151,173),('A',200,225),('A',247,277),('A',286,309)])
S['KcsA channel (1BL8)']=dict(df=parse_txt(get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/1BL8.pdb'),chains=set('ABCD')),
    tm=[(c,23,51) for c in 'ABCD']+[(c,86,119) for c in 'ABCD'])

def axes(df,tm):
    vs=[]
    for ch,a,b in tm:
        s=df[(df.ch==ch)&(df.atom=='CA')&(df.resi.between(a,b))].sort_values('resi')[['x','y','z']].values
        if len(s)<5: continue
        v=s[-1]-s[0]; vs.append(v/np.linalg.norm(v))
    vs=np.array(vs); ref=vs[0]; vs=np.array([v if v@ref>0 else -v for v in vs])
    ax=vs.mean(0); ax/=np.linalg.norm(ax)
    tmp=np.array([1.,0,0]) if abs(ax[0])<0.9 else np.array([0.,1,0])
    e1=np.cross(ax,tmp); e1/=np.linalg.norm(e1); e2=np.cross(ax,e1)
    tmca=np.vstack([df[(df.ch==c)&(df.atom=='CA')&(df.resi.between(a,b))][['x','y','z']].values for c,a,b in tm])
    return ax,e1,e2,tmca.mean(0),tmca

def enclosed(uv, A, nsect=12, cut=20.0):
    D=A-uv; d=np.linalg.norm(D,axis=1); m=d<=cut
    if m.sum()<nsect: return False
    sec=((np.arctan2(D[m,1],D[m,0])+np.pi)/(2*np.pi)*nsect).astype(int)%nsect
    return len(np.unique(sec))==nsect

rows=[]; portal_res=None
for k,v in S.items():
    df=v['df']; X=df[['x','y','z']].values; rv=np.array([VDW.get(e,1.7) for e in df.el.values])
    ax,e1,e2,cen,tmca=axes(df,v['tm']); tree=cKDTree(X)
    zc=(X-cen)@ax; zt=(tmca-cen)@ax; zlo,zhi=np.percentile(zt,15),np.percentile(zt,85)
    g=np.arange(-14,14.01,1.0); U,V=np.meshgrid(g,g); UV0=np.c_[U.ravel(),V.ravel()]
    UV0=UV0[np.linalg.norm(UV0,axis=1)<=14]
    best=(-1,None,None)
    for z in np.arange(zlo,zhi+.01,1.5):
        P=cen+np.outer(UV0[:,0],e1)+np.outer(UV0[:,1],e2)+z*ax
        d,i=tree.query(P,k=25); r=(d-rv[i]).min(1)
        A=np.c_[(X[np.abs(zc-z)<=6.0]-cen)@e1,(X[np.abs(zc-z)<=6.0]-cen)@e2]
        for j in np.argsort(-r)[:300]:
            if enclosed(UV0[j],A):
                if r[j]>best[0]: best=(float(r[j]),P[j],float(z))
                break
    rmax,C,zbest=best
    th=np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,180,endpoint=False); t=np.arange(0.5,24.01,0.5)
    prof=np.empty(len(th))
    for n,a_ in enumerate(th):
        dvec=np.cos(a_)*e1+np.sin(a_)*e2
        P=C+np.outer(t,dvec); d,i=tree.query(P,k=25); prof[n]=(d-rv[i]).min(1).min()
    jb=int(np.argmax(prof))
    rows.append(dict(structure=k,z_of_cavity=round(zbest,1),interior_radius=round(rmax,2),
                     portal_radius=round(float(prof.max()),2),
                     rays_ge_1_8=int((prof>=1.8).sum()),rays_ge_2_5=int((prof>=2.5).sum())))
    if k.startswith('PTM1'):
        dvec=np.cos(th[jb])*e1+np.sin(th[jb])*e2; P=C+np.outer(t,dvec)
        hit=sorted({int(r_) for sub in tree.query_ball_point(P,6.0) for r_ in df.iloc[sub].resi.values})
        aa=dict(zip(df.resi,df.aa)); portal_res=[f"{aa[r_]}{r_}" for r_ in hit]
T=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(T.to_string(index=False))
print("\nPTM1 residues within 6 A of the widest lateral path from the cavity (n=%d):"%len(portal_res))
print(", ".join(portal_res))

fig,axx=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.2))
c=['#1f77b4','#2ca02c','#7f7f7f','#d62728']
axx[0].bar(range(4),T.interior_radius,color=c); axx[0].set_xticks(range(4))
axx[0].set_xticklabels(T.structure,rotation=20,fontsize=8,ha='right')
axx[0].set_ylabel('enclosed interior radius (A)'); axx[0].set_title('Mid-membrane cavity width')
axx[1].bar(range(4),T.portal_radius,color=c); axx[1].set_xticks(range(4))
axx[1].set_xticklabels(T.structure,rotation=20,fontsize=8,ha='right')
axx[1].axhline(2.0,ls='--',c='k',lw=1); axx[1].text(-0.45,2.08,'acyl chain ~2.0 A',fontsize=8)
axx[1].set_ylabel('largest probe reaching the bilayer (A)'); axx[1].set_title('Lateral opening from cavity to lipid')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
